PLAN "12-week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control for T2D"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve body composition and glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full body strength A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Conditioning + core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 10x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body strength B":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full body strength A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x35..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Interval conditioning + core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 12x1..2 rpe 6 rest 50 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body strength B":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:

    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength progression A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds

          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Low impact conditioning":

          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:

      DAY Friday training 55m "Strength progression B":

        cooldown:

    WEEK 4:

        warmup:

        main straight_sets:

          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Active recovery":
        warmup:

        main straight_sets:

          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 55m "Deload strength":
        warmup:

          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:

        main straight_sets:

          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Conditioning + lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 12x1..2 rpe 7 rest 50 seconds
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 60m "Full body heavy":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x50..70 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Conditioning + lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 14x1..2 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full body heavy":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Metabolic circuit":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 8x1..2 rpe 8 rest 40 seconds
          kettlebell_swing 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Recovery week":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Low impact cardio":
        warmup:
          elliptical 10m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 10x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower maintenance":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3 - Intensification & Maintenance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Power & strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 16x1..1 rpe 8 rest 40 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength density":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Metabolic conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 12x1..2 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          kettlebell_swing 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Mixed hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Maintain strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Active recovery + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 8x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full body maintenance":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload and reassess":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Light cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 8x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Maintenance session":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m

NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Energy: Moderate calorie deficit ~300..500 kcal/day below maintenance to support fat loss while minimizing hypoglycaemia risk."
    - "Protein: 1.2..1.6 g/kg body weight per day distributed across meals; prioritize lean sources and dairy if tolerated."
    - "Carbohydrate timing: Distribute carbohydrate evenly across meals (3..4 meals/day) to avoid large post-meal glucose spikes; include 20..40 g carbohydrate with resistance training sessions and 15..30 g with light activity sessions as needed."
    - "Carbohydrate quality: Prioritize whole grains, legumes, vegetables, fruits (low glycaemic load choices), and avoid sugar-sweetened beverages and high-GI starchy snacks."
    - "Fats: Include healthy fats (olive oil, nuts, avocado) roughly 25..35% of energy."
    - "Fiber: Aim for 25..35 g fiber/day to improve glycaemic control (vegetables, legumes, whole grains)."
    - "Meal examples: Breakfast — Greek yogurt + oats + berries; Lunch — grilled chicken salad + quinoa; Dinner — salmon + mixed vegetables + small sweet potato; Snacks — apple + nuts, hummus + veg sticks."
    - "Hydration: 2..3 L water/day; avoid sugary drinks."
    - "Alcohol: Limit intake; prefer low-carb options and avoid heavy drinking around medication timing."
    - "Medication considerations: Continue metformin as prescribed; monitor capillary glucose around higher-intensity sessions. Because on metformin hypoglycaemia risk is low but possible when combined with prolonged exercise, carry a fast-acting carbohydrate source (15..20 g) during workouts and check symptoms."
    - "Progress monitoring: Weekly weight and weekly fasting glucose reading; adjust calories if fasting glucose trends upward or undue hypoglycaemia occurs."
    - "Referrals: Advise regular GP/endocrinologist follow-up and diabetes educator for medication adjustment if starting higher volumes/intensities."
    - "Safety: If experiencing dizziness, palpitations, sweating, confusion during exercise — stop and check blood glucose; if <4 mmol/L consume 15..20 g fast carbohydrate, retest after 15 minutes."
  MACRONUTRIENT_TARGETS:
    - calories_deficit "300..500 kcal/day"
    - protein "1.2..1.6 g/kg/day"
    - carbs "40..45% of energy, prioritize low glycaemic load choices"
    - fat "25..35% of energy"
  SAMPLE_MEAL_PLAN:
    - "Breakfast: Greek yogurt (or low-fat cottage cheese) 150g + 30g oats + 50g berries + 10g nuts."
    - "Lunch: Grilled chicken 100..150g + mixed salad (large) + 50g cooked quinoa + olive oil dressing."
    - "Pre-work snack (if training): 1 small banana or 2 rice cakes + 1 tbsp peanut butter (15..30 g carbs)."
    - "Post-work meal: Protein (20..30g) + mixed vegetables + 30..40g starchy carbohydrate for training days."
    - "Dinner: Baked fish 120..150g + non-starchy vegetables + 100g roasted sweet potato (or equivalent)."
    - "Snacks: Apple + 15g almonds; raw veg sticks + 50g hummus."
  MONITORING:
    - "Record pre- and post-exercise capillary glucose the first 2 weeks of increased training intensity to ensure safe responses."
    - "Adjust carbohydrate around sessions if blood glucose trends low (<4 mmol/L) or high (>10 mmol/L) — consult clinician for medication changes."
    - "Reassess weight, HbA1c with clinician at 12 weeks."

VISITATION
  CHECK_INS:
    - "Weekly trainer check-in: review adherence, symptoms, and adjust training intensity."
    - "Bi-weekly nutrition check: review food log, carbohydrate distribution, and fiber intake."

END_PLAN
